headline: Inject Expert Engineering Practices Into Claude Code
lede: Matt Pocock introduces a modular library of skills that forces AI agents to follow rigorous software methodologies. By implementing custom TDD and architectural commands, developers can transform basic code generators into disciplined engineering partners.

headline: Standardize Your AI Agent Workflow With ECC
lede: ECC provides a unified harness to manage persistence, memory, and security across multi-session AI development cycles. It bridges the gap between ad-hoc prompting and industrial-grade software engineering through structured rule sets.

headline: Ponytail Enforces Code Minimalism For Senior Developers
lede: This plugin forces AI agents to exhaustively prioritize native platform features before resorting to new dependencies. By reducing bloat at the source, it ensures long-term codebase maintainability.

headline: Build A Self-Improving Agent With Hermes
lede: Hermes Agent offers a persistent memory loop that evolves alongside your unique coding preferences. Its model-agnostic design allows it to run anywhere from local machines to cloud VPS, adapting its behavior over time.

headline: fmt Replaces Legacy C++ String Formatting
lede: This performance-oriented library provides a modern, type-safe alternative to stdio and iostreams. It optimizes execution speed and reduces binary bloat for high-frequency trading and database systems.

headline: Standardize Agent Behaviors Using Anthropics Skills
lede: The official skill hub provides a YAML-based specification for guiding Claude’s decision-making on complex tasks. It enables developers to codify internal knowledge into repeatable, modular instructions for AI assistants.

headline: Generate Brand-Aligned Diagrams With AI
lede: This tool produces editorial-quality SVGs that adhere strictly to your existing design system tokens. It eliminates the friction of manual styling by mapping architectural concepts directly to branded templates.

headline: OpenCode Streamlines Multi-Agent Development
lede: Designed for power users, OpenCode offers a dedicated CLI interface for managing complex agent tasks with granular safety controls. It allows developers to switch between build-focused and exploration-focused agent modes seamlessly.

headline: Ruflo Orchestrates Autonomous Agent Swarms
lede: Ruflo serves as a Rust-based execution engine that integrates specialized agents into a cohesive operating system. It manages state, vector databases, and federated communication to facilitate high-throughput engineering workflows.

headline: Expand Your Claude Code Capabilities With HumanLayer
lede: This repository curates a collection of specialized plugins for enhancing AI development automation. It provides the essential modular components required to bootstrap sophisticated agentic loops and documentation standards.
